page.overview:
What is Blue Planet?

The Blue Planet is the celestial body on which One Piece takes place. While similar to real-life in many aspects, it is drastically different in others. The Blue Planet primarily consists of the Blue Sea, with the Red Line as its only continent above sea level. Much of the population lives on assorted islands scattered across the Blue Sea, which is divided into the East Blue, North Blue, South Blue, West Blue, Calm Belts, and the Grand Line, itself made up of Paradise and the New World.

According to Dr. Vegapunk, the Blue Planet used to have a different configuration a millennium ago, with far more landmasses and less ocean until the events of the Void Century, which caused sea levels to rise and whole continents to disappear. As of the present, there are over 20,000,000 islands in the world, and Vegapunk predicts that these islands will soon be entirely sunk into the Blue Sea.

Since the end of the Void Century 800 years ago, the World Government governs most of the Blue Planet, having played a large role in its current geographical configuration. Throughout history, many prominent figures and organizations have gone against the World Government in power struggles for various parts of the world.

The term is first revealed in Enel's Great Space Operations and confirmed to be the name of the planet in SBS Volume 111. The ancestors of the sky island inhabitants, a race of alien beings from the moon, are the first group in the story to use the term Blue Planet on the cover page of Chapter 472.
